# 1 Enoch Chapter 38 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**38:1** The First Parable. When the congregation of the righteous shall appear, and sinners are judged for their sins and driven from the face of the dry ground —

**38:2** when the Righteous One appears before the eyes of the elect, whose works are weighed by the Lord of Spirits, and light appears to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the dry ground — where then will be the dwelling place of the sinners, and where the resting place of those who have denied the Lord of Spirits? It would have been better for them had they never been born.

**38:3** When the secrets of the Righteous One are revealed, he shall judge the sinners; the wicked will not be able to look upon the face of the holy ones, for the light of the Lord of Spirits will shine upon the face of the holy, the righteous, and the elect.

**38:4** And the kings and the mighty shall at that time perish, and be given into the hands of the righteous and the holy.

**38:5** And from that time forward none shall seek mercy for themselves from the Lord of Spirits, for their life will have reached its end.

**38:6** And it shall come to pass in those days that they will be unable to save themselves by gold or silver, and none shall escape. There will be no iron for war, nor breastplate for battle; bronze shall profit nothing, tin shall be of no use, and lead shall not be valued. All these things shall be cast aside and destroyed from the surface of the earth when the Elect One appears before the face of the Lord of Spirits.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Strong consensus across all three agents. Key decision: "Elect One" (EMET/LOGOS) retained in v. 6 over PNEUMA's "Chosen One" — "Elect One" is the established technical term for this figure throughout the Parables. "Dry ground" (EMET/LOGOS) preserved over PNEUMA's "earth." See disagreement log.*
